summary: No changes: the City of Atlantic's Sunnyside Park page refused (Cloudflare block) and no other official page describes the campground, so the rate, who runs the camping and the stored hookups/sites/booking stay unverified. Camper reports put it at $15-20 a night, self-serve, on ordinary nights. Not waterfront kept.
flags: OPERATOR PAGE UNREAD: cityofatlantic.com answered a Cloudflare security block; not retried by another route. The rate, the operator of the camping (city vs. a fair association) and whether it is reservable could not be read from any official page.

NO STORED RATE (still none): camper reports only (RV Life): $20 a night 9/2025 (motorhome, pull-through site 1), $15 in 2019-2022, 6/2020 tip '$15 cash or check only...self serve.' Not written (the operator has a page, so camper reports can't price it).

FAIRGROUNDS / NIGHTLY OUTSIDE EVENTS: no official text read. Camper reports describe ordinary nights with nobody else there (6/2020 'a Friday night in June, and were the only ones here'; 9/2025 overnight, 9/2022 stop off the highway), so ordinary nights do appear to be sold, self-serve. Who runs the camping is unconfirmed: the stored note says City of Atlantic; casscountyfair.org, the fair association's likely domain, is now a coupon spam site.
BOOKING: stored reservable true is note-derived and unconfirmed; camper tips say self-serve cash/check, which suggests first-come. Left alone for want of an official page.

PHONE: stored 712-243-3542 matches the Google Maps result (4.5 stars, 125 reviews); the Chamber lists the Atlantic Parks & Recreation Office as (712) 254-0637 at 1200 Sunnyside Lane. I could not tell which the city gives for camping.

PIN: stored 41.3990,-95.0250 lies in the park's wooded loop-road area west of the fairground barns; Google's result is ~250 m south (41.39672,-95.02527). I could not identify the camping pads on imagery, so no correction is proposed.
